title: not oder less some char
text:
not oder less some char. I have had worse oil from Wal-mart, but this oil is still not what I am looking for.
My sense of smell is almost nonexistant and I can smell something when I pour it. That says to me it must be awfull to everyone else. I got some char on my chimny. not as bad as wally worlds but more than I wanted. I have to keep my wick short to prevent smoke so my lamp only throws about the same as a night light worth of light.
Oil lamps are suposed to throw a little more light giveing them the advantage over a candle.
